items.stem:
A balanced string of parentheses is a string where every opening parenthesis “(” is matched by a corresponding closing parenthesis “)”, and no closing parenthesis “)” appears before its matching opening parenthesis “(”.
For example:
•"(()()(()))" is a balanced string.
•"))))((((" is not a balanced string, since closing parentheses come before any opening ones.
•"(()(())" is not a balanced string since there is an unmatched opening parenthesis.
Karl plans to write a program to check if an inputted string is balanced using a stack, the following are the functions used in the algorithm.
Function
Description
push(S, T)
Insert an element T on top of stack S.
pop(S)
Return and remove the topmost element from stack S.
isEmpty(S)
Returns True if the stack S is empty, otherwise False.
clearStack(S)
Clear the stack S to make it become empty stack.
The following is the initial content in the stack temp:
temp

3

4
flag  True
5

6
while i < L and flag = True
7
if arr[i] = "(" then
8

9

10

11

14

16
